target.title: Fix login-shell probe cleanup
target.body:
## Summary

- Defer login-shell PATH capture until the Codex RPC launch boundary and skip it when a valid `CODEX_CLI_PATH` override is present.
- Adopt raw `posix_spawn` PATH probes into `SpawnedProcessGroup` so timeout and normal-exit cleanup also finds helpers that escape the original session while retaining stdout or stderr.
- Add deterministic regression coverage for session-escaped output holders and explicit override resolution.

## Root cause

The PATH runner only killed the session's original process group. Shell startup helpers could call `setsid()`, retain a probe output pipe, and survive that cleanup. Separately, `UsageFetcher` started a fire-and-forget login-shell capture during initialization even when the eventual Codex launch had an explicit executable override.

## Validation

- `make check`
  - SwiftFormat: 0 files require formatting
  - SwiftLint: 0 violations in 1,427 files
- `HOME=/private/tmp/codexbar-test-home-full-final CFFIXED_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/codexbar-test-home-full-final CODEXBAR_SUPPRESS_TEST_KEYCHAIN_ACCESS=1 CODEXBAR_TEST_GROUP_SIZE=4 CODEXBAR_TEST_SUITE_TIMEOUT=120 CODEXBAR_TEST_RETRY_NON_TIMEOUT_FAILURES=0 ./Scripts/test.sh`
  - exact HEAD `1d480a59e26e67f46852e90ff9da2e2c7a739f41`
  - 640/640 selections, 160/160 groups
  - 0 failures, 0 retries, 0 timeouts
  - 352.1 seconds
- `HOME=/private/tmp/codexbar-test-home-focused-final CFFIXED_USER_HOME=/private/tmp/codexbar-test-home-focused-final CODEXBAR_SUPPRESS_TEST_KEYCHAIN_ACCESS=1 swift test --filter 'ShellCommandLocatorProcessTests|CodexExecutableResolverTests|PathBuilderTests|SpawnedProcessGroupTests'`
  - 64 tests in 4 suites passed
- Isolated public-CLI proof with the same login-shell fixture and `CODEX_CLI_PATH=/usr/bin/false`:
  - base `c852c135e10cfdfb047895bd13c1a4425ded4afb`: spawned a session-escaped helper that remained alive after the CLI returned
  - HEAD: no login-shell probe was started
  - exact surviving `/bin/zsh -l -i -c printf __CODEXBAR_PATH__` probes after cleanup: 0
  - proof manifest and hashed artifacts: https://gist.github.com/anagnorisis2peripeteia/1b3ab2a0f2ee613c442f26e4f72507a7

<details>
<summary>Validated proof manifest</summary>

  "head_sha": "1d480a59e26e67f46852e90ff9da2e2c7a739f41",
  "before": {
    "revision": "c852c135e10cfdfb047895bd13c1a4425ded4afb",
    "result": "limitation",
    "command": "env HOME=<isolated-home> CODEX_HOME=<isolated-home>/.codex ZDOTDIR=<fixture> SHELL=/bin/zsh CODEX_CLI_PATH=/usr/bin/false CODEXBAR_PROBE_PID_FILE=<pid-file> .build/debug/CodexBarCLI usage --provider codex --source oauth --format json; wait 1 second; inspect <pid-file>",
    "observation": "Current main launched the login-shell fixture before the explicit Codex override was used; its session-escaped helper remained alive after the CLI returned.",
    "artifacts": ["before-base.txt"]
  },
  "after": {
    "revision": "1d480a59e26e67f46852e90ff9da2e2c7a739f41",
    "result": "success",
    "command": "env HOME=<isolated-home> CODEX_HOME=<isolated-home>/.codex ZDOTDIR=<fixture> SHELL=/bin/zsh CODEX_CLI_PATH=/usr/bin/false CODEXBAR_PROBE_PID_FILE=<pid-file> .build/debug/CodexBarCLI usage --provider codex --source oauth --format json; wait 1 second; inspect <pid-file>",
    "observation": "The proposed revision honored the explicit Codex override without starting the login-shell fixture; no helper PID file was created.",
    "artifacts": ["after-head.txt"]
  },
  "artifact_sha256": {
    "before-base.txt": "f6cbcfe40dc807c5792e7440202aebcf317d7831c2bb9e4f47167ea2c82ef310",
    "after-head.txt": "c96f79d7ef1ed6bb3662c0aeb742fd6c65ef9e5ae6ab6aac4af229f9aa865276"
  },

Screenshots are not applicable because this is non-renderable subprocess lifecycle behavior.

## Out of scope

The separately observed Codex `auth.json` deletion is not part of this change. This patch does not read, write, refresh, or remove Codex authentication state, and validation used isolated homes without real account, browser-cookie, or Keychain access.
